mapper.select:
SELECT q.id, q.title, q.content, q.status, q.create_time, q.course_id, u.name AS studentName, c.name AS courseName, tu.name AS teacherName, qf.file_url FROM question q LEFT JOIN user u ON q.student_id = u.id LEFT JOIN course c ON q.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN question_file qf ON q.id = qf.question_id
LEFT JOIN class cls ON q.class_id = cls.id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON cls.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN user tu ON t.user_id = tu.id
WHERE 1=1
AND q.course_id = #{dto.courseId}
AND tu.name LIKE concat('%', #{dto.teacherName}, '%')
AND ( q.title LIKE concat('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') OR q.content LIKE concat('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY q.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question(title, content, course_id, student_id, class_id, status, create_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{courseId}, #{studentId}, (SELECT class_id FROM student_class WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} LIMIT 1), 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT q.*, u.name AS studentName, c.name AS courseName, qf.file_url FROM question q LEFT JOIN user u ON q.student_id = u.id LEFT JOIN course c ON q.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN question_file qf ON q.id = qf.question_id WHERE q.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.content, a.create_time, a.teacher_id, u.name AS teacherName, af.file_url FROM answer a LEFT JOIN teacher t ON a.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN user u ON t.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN answer_file af ON a.id = af.answer_id WHERE a.question_id = #{questionId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.create_time ASC

SELECT a.id, a.content, a.create_time, a.teacher_id, u.name AS teacherName, af.file_url FROM answer a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN answer_file af ON a.id = af.answer_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE af FROM answer_file af INNER JOIN answer a ON af.answer_id = a.id WHERE a.question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.select: SELECT student_id FROM question WHERE id = #{id}
